home-nav.title: Home
home-nav.description: Your daily dashboard — pending actions, recent activity, and quick links tailored to your role. Start every morning here.

profile-nav.title: My Profile
profile-nav.description: View and update your personal info, contact details, and professional summary. Other modules like OKRs and performance link back to this.

leaves-nav.title: Leaves
leaves-nav.description: Submit and track your leave requests, check remaining balances per leave type, and view your full request history.

org-chart-nav.title: Org Chart
org-chart-nav.description: Explore the company structure — departments, teams, and reporting lines — in an interactive tree. Navigate to any employee profile directly.

performance-nav.title: Performance Reviews
performance-nav.description: Complete self-assessments and view manager feedback across active review cycles. Track your ratings over time.

okrs-nav.title: OKRs
okrs-nav.description: Your single hub for Objectives & Key Results — track personal OKRs, view cycle-wide progress, and manage cycles and check-ins, all in one place.

dashboard-nav.title: Analytics Dashboard
dashboard-nav.description: A Power BI–style hub with real-time KPIs: headcount trends, payroll summaries, leave patterns, and engagement scores. Toggle chart types per panel.

simulation-nav.title: Simulation
simulation-nav.description: Model workforce changes before committing — propose promotions, transfers, or restructuring. The AI Agent analyses cost and skills impact.

employees-nav.title: Employees
employees-nav.description: The central employee registry — create employees, update details, manage role assignments, track salary history, and view skills profiles.

leave-mgmt-nav.title: Leave Management
leave-mgmt-nav.description: Review and approve or reject pending leave requests. Configure leave types, accrual rules, carry-over policies, and view the full team calendar.

positions-nav.title: Positions
positions-nav.description: Define and maintain the job position catalog. Each position carries required skills and salary bands — powering skills-gap analysis and the AI Career Agent.

notifications-bell.title: Notifications
notifications-bell.description: Stay updated on leave approvals, review requests, OKR check-in reminders, and other important events — all in one inbox.

dark-mode-toggle.title: Dark Mode
dark-mode-toggle.description: Prefer working in the dark? Toggle between light and dark themes anytime from the sidebar footer. Your preference is saved automatically.

linked-channels-tab.title: Linked Channels
linked-channels-tab.description: Sentient answers in Slack and Telegram too. Link your account once from this tab on your profile and you can check a balance or book leave without opening the app.

linked-channel-telegram.title: Get your Telegram code
linked-channel-telegram.description: Press Connect and Sentient issues a single-use 6-digit code. Open Telegram, message {{botHandle}}, and send it "/link" followed by that code — the dialog spells out the exact command and has a copy button.

linked-channel-slack.title: Get your Slack code
linked-channel-slack.description: Same for Slack: press Connect, then direct-message the {{appName}} app "link" and the code — with no leading slash, which Slack would swallow as a slash command. Codes are short-lived, so generate a fresh one here if yours expires before you send it.
